cron.title: Close Tickets
cron.description: This task closes tickets that have had no activity for a certain period of time.

cron.title: Unlock Tickets
cron.description: This task unlocks tickets that have been locked for too long, preventing other techs from handling it.

cron.title: Ticket Reminders
cron.description: Sends emails to techs about tickets they are watching.

cron.title: Knowledgebase Subscriptions
cron.description: Sends users category and article knowledgebase subscriptions.

cron.title: Manual Exports
cron.description: Exports manual images to the filesystems, generates manual downloads.

cron.title: Incomplete Ticket Reminders
cron.description: Sends reminder emails to users when they have incomplete ticket submissions

cron.title: Resend Failed Emails
cron.description: Attempts to resend emails that faield sending the first time (i.e., if a temporary SMTP outage occurred).

cron.title: Expire User Subscriptions
cron.description: Expires user subscription plans and reverses them.

cron.title: Prune Sessions
cron.description: Deletes old session records from the database, and for techs, inserts timelog data.

cron.title: Send updates to ideas
cron.description: Sends notifications when ideas have been updated
